notes.title: Pull Stay will leave Early Access and enter the v1.0 full release on 31 March!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/c59296fb6d5e42f237dd37b2bab49a39d9800bbb.gif[/img]

[h3]Pull Stay will finally enter the v1.0 full release on [b]31 March![/b][/h3]

Thank you so much for helping me improve the game throughout the EA period🙏

Share and repost are very much appreciated!

notes.title: Early Access 2.4.2 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b][Bug Fix][/b]
[list]
[*] The game could crash when you did Giant Swing and threw an enemy away at the last stage
[*] It was impossible to get the Steam Achievement "Hop on Their Heads!"(Defeat 3 enemies who were dehydrated by a Washing Machine)
[/list]

...and other small fixes and improvements

notes.title: Early Access 2.4.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]

[list]
[*] Enemies did not catch Susumu even though they already reached him
[*] In Endless Mode, Susumu has a limitation on the amount he can make items, but the calculation had been broken and the game got stuck
[/list]

Thanks @watermelon for the bug reports!

notes.title: The next update plan (Early Access 1.3)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
The next update of Pull Stay will be huge!
I've been working on [b]a new mini-boss, a new normal stage, a new enemy, and a new move.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36194937/106f3afb469430edaf778a6e3bf5ebac4b99c805.gif[/img]

It's rather straightforward to implement them all at once.
So it would take a bit more time but the development is going smoothly.
I appreciate your patience and feedback (´▽｀)

notes.title: The release date will be pushed back to the latter part of this year😢
notes.notes:
I am deeply sorry to say this, but [b]I need to push back the release date for several months.[/b]
The main reason is that I need to get out of my current apartment due to my family situation. I explained it in this video:
[previewyoutube=1sNY31pQung;full][/previewyoutube]
Also, I want more development time because I have come up with new ideas to implement as the development has progressed further. To fulfill the theme of this game, I feel I can't cut it short.
Sorry for asking for your patience again. I will definitely keep working hard!

notes.title: The release date will be push backed to April 2023
notes.notes:
I pushed back the release date one year
[b]The new date is April 2023[/b]
Because the development workload has exceeded my initial estimation
I am very sorry about that 😥
On top of the development itself, also I need to handle the marketing aspect and my financial situation
Honestly, it's quite challenging for me as a solo developer

With that said, the development of Pull Stay has kept moving forward constantly
You can check my working live stream every Wednesday (´▽｀)
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVWDm8aMhKc6cZSFLVV7I3g
